claim: pytest resolves the relative `--ignore=tests/connectors` path in `addopts` against the rootdir, so the default run skips collection of that directory regardless of the working directory pytest is invoked from.
verify_against: pytest's documented resolution of relative `--ignore` paths supplied via `addopts` in `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`, and the rootdir pytest computes for this repo
verify_hint: Check pytest's `--ignore` / `addopts` path-resolution docs for the pinned pytest version in requirements.txt against the `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` block in pyproject.toml

claim: Naming `tests/connectors` explicitly on the pytest command line still runs those tests despite the `--ignore=tests/connectors` entry in `addopts`.
source_excerpt:
# tests/connectors/ needs live Postgres and MySQL, so a default run leaves it
# uncollected rather than deselected or skipped. Naming it explicitly still
# runs it: `pytest -q tests/connectors`.
verify_against: pytest's precedence rules between `--ignore` and explicitly named collection arguments, for the pytest version this repo pins
verify_hint: Run or check pytest docs for `--ignore` vs explicit path args; confirm with the pytest pin in requirements.txt / pyproject `[project.optional-dependencies].dev`

verify_hint: Grep for `mark.connectors` and `pytestmark` across tests/ and compare with the files under tests/connectors/ (currently only test_connectors.py)

verify_hint: Resolve ../../../tests/connectors/test_connectors.py from docs/internal/database-connectors/ and confirm the file exists at tests/connectors/test_connectors.py

claim: The default `pytest -q` run reports no skipped and no deselected tests at all.
source_excerpt:
`pytest -q` is the whole-suite verification command. It reports no skipped
or deselected tests: the live Postgres/MySQL connector tests live in
`tests/connectors/`, which pyproject's `addopts` ignores, so the default run
does not collect them.
verify_against: Every `pytest.skip`, `skipif`, `importorskip` and conditional-skip site in tests/ outside tests/connectors/
verify_hint: Grep tests/ (excluding tests/connectors/) for `pytest.skip`, `pytest.mark.skip`, `skipif`, `importorskip` and `xfail`; a platform- or dependency-gated skip on the Linux CI runner would falsify the claim

claim: Every connector test under tests/connectors/ skips itself when its Postgres/MySQL URL env var is unset.
source_excerpt:
Do not run `pytest tests/connectors` as completion verification without
`SQLLENS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` and `SQLLENS_TEST_MYSQL_URL`: each test skips
itself when its URL is unset.
verify_hint: Check every test function and fixture in tests/connectors/test_connectors.py for an env-var skip guard; the PR's own note of "3 passed, 17 skipped" without URLs suggests some tests do not skip

claim: CI's `request-review` job is skipped exactly on non-`pull_request` runs (push, merge_group), draft PRs, fork PRs, dependabot PRs, and when `DEVFLOW_APP_ID` is unset — and those are the enumerated conditions.
source_excerpt:
The `CI` workflow's `request-review` job is skipped by design on every
non-`pull_request` run (push, `merge_group`), on draft, fork and dependabot
pull requests, and whenever the `DEVFLOW_APP_ID` repository variable is unset.

verify_hint: Compare each clause of the `if:` at .github/workflows/ci.yml lines 167-172 (and the `needs: [unit, connectors]` gate) with the five conditions this doc enumerates

`request-review` as passed.

claim: The fake-driver cleanup tests in tests/unit/test_sql_runner_cleanup.py run in the default `pytest -q` pass and require neither pymysql nor psycopg2 to be installed.
source_excerpt: Each test installs a fake `pymysql` / `psycopg2` module via `monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, ...)`, so the suite does **not** require either driver to be installed and runs in the default `pytest -q` pass (which does not collect `tests/connectors/`).
verify_against: tests/unit/test_sql_runner_cleanup.py and the new `addopts` in pyproject.toml
verify_hint: Check that tests/unit/test_sql_runner_cleanup.py lives outside tests/connectors/, carries no `connectors` marker or driver `importorskip`, and that every test there monkeypatches sys.modules
